content: यवनः [यु-युच्] .²1 A Greek, an Ionian. .²2 Any foreigner, or barbarian; <ls>Ms. 10. 44</ls>; (the word is applied at present to a Mahomedan or a European also). .²3 A carrot. .²4 Olibanum. .²5 A courser or swift horse. .²6 Speed. .²7 Wheat. .²8 A kind of grass. .{@-नाः@} ({%m.%} <ab>pl.</ab>) .²1 The Ionians or Greeks. .²2 The Greek astrologers. .{@-नम्@} Mixing, mingling (<ab>esp.</ab> with water).
